attchmntText: Mstc Limited has informed the Exchange about the Transcript of conference call with the Investors/Analyst held on Friday, 13th November, 2026 at 11:00 AM IST.
voiceSummary: MSTC Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY 27 earnings conference call held on November 13, 2026. The company reported record H1 results with revenue from operations increasing by over 25% year-on-year to INR 204.26 crore. Profit after tax rose by nearly 42% to INR 132.72 crore, while EBITDA grew to INR 184.55 crore. Management highlighted the receipt of in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India for a new Trade Receivable Discounting System platform, subject to final authorization. The EPR certificate exchange remains pending stakeholder operationalization decisions. Joint venture MMRPL posted its first positive H1 profit of INR 0.82 crore after ten years of losses. The company also noted significant auction activities, including INR 2,863 crore for Telangana land parcels and INR 125 crore for Karnataka liquor licenses.

attchmntText: Mstc Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of audio recording of conference call with the Investors/ Analyst to discuss the Financial performance of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 held on Friday, 13th November, 2026 at 11:00 AM.
voiceSummary: MSTC Limited has made available the audio recording of the conference call with investors and analysts held on 13 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The discussion covered the financial performance for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The recording is accessible on the company website at https://www.mstcindia.co.in/cms/Investor/MSTCConcall13112026.mp3. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The notice was issued by Ajay Kumar Rai, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The company is a Government of India Enterprise with CIN L27320WB1964GO1026211. Scrip codes are 542597 for BSE and MSTCLTD for NSE.

attchmntText: Mstc Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of the Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
voiceSummary: MSTC Limited published its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 in newspapers on 13 November 2026. The announcement confirms the publication of the extract of financial results as required under SEBI LODR Regulations. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, the standalone total income was 13,921.14 and net profit after tax was 7,460.56. The consolidated total income was 13,921.14 and consolidated net profit after tax was 7,491.89. Basic earnings per share for the standalone half year was 10.59. The consolidated basic earnings per share was 10.64. Paid up equity share capital remains 7,040.00 with a face value of Rs. 10. The full financial results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.
